1445-4871-6351-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6351-7272.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3678-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
3678-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 white Kor Ally creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

813-1987-2320.easyPrerequisites:

Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Ghostly Flicker.
You control another nontoken artifact, creature, or land.
813-1987-2320.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and one other legal target, and putting Ghostly Flicker into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Splash Portal by tapping Warden of the Eye due to Splash Portal's convoke ability, blinking Warden of the Eye.

Repeat.

2023-4518-4927-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-3967-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3967-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-864-3125-4247-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4247-6351.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, its living weapon ability granted to it by Ekthi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token. It'll enter as a 1/1 due to Ekthi's static effect.
When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.
Repeat from step 2.

4302-4509-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another Angel.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

Activate Extruder by sacrificing another artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.

Repeat.

691-5007-6186-7395.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
691-5007-6186-7395.description:
Activate Words of War by paying {1}.
Attempt to draw a card. The draw will be replaced by Words of War targeting Morselhoarder. The 2 damage will instead place two -1/-1 counters on Morselhoarder due to Everlasting Torment.
Auntie Ool triggers. Holding priority, activate Morselhoarder twice by removing two -1/-1 counters from it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Words of War by paying {1}.
Resolve the Auntie Ool trigger, attempting to draw a card. The draw will be replaced by Words of War targeting Morselhoarder. The 2 damage will instead place two -1/-1 counters on Morselhoarder due to Everlasting Torment.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Lyse Hext. 
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Sculpting Steel. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Super-Skrull's first ability by paying {W} due to Biomancer's Familiar, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wall, adding {W}.
Repeat.

527-955-1409.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

373-877-6844.description:
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying {0}.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

645-2060-2981-3750-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-2981-3750-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
4120-4968-5430.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

1793-4050-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1793-4050-6249--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the persist creature dies, it and Harvester of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Breaching Hippocamp
2440-4055-4183-4894.description:

When the token Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Breaching Hippocamp trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Breaching Hippocamp, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Breaching Hippocamp for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Energy Refractor twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

When the Insect enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.

Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

190-1241-1321.description:

Activate Lantern of the Lost by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling it, exiling all cards from all graveyards and drawing a card.

Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
